    AI Overview
    Ben McCollum is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Iowa, hired on March 24, 2025, as the 23rd coach in program history. An Iowa native, McCollum led the Hawkeyes to the 2026 NCAA Tournament in his first season. For women's basketball, Jan Jensen is the head coach, leading the team to a No. 2 seed in the 2026 NCAA Tournament. 
    This video shows Iowa men's basketball coach Ben McCollum after a game in the NCAA Tournament:
    58s
    The Gazette
    YouTube• Mar 15, 2026
    Key Details About Ben McCollum (Men's Basketball): 
    • Background:
      Born in Iowa City and grew up attending Hawkeye games, he was previously a highly successful coach at Northwest Missouri State.
    • Style: Known for an offensive style focused on crisp passing and structure.
    • 2025-26 Season: Became the only new Big Ten head coach to lead his team to the 2026 NCAA Tournament. 
    Key Details About Jan Jensen (Women's Basketball): 
    • Role: Took over as head coach after serving as the associate head coach for 24 years under Lisa Bluder.
    • Success: Led the team to a 26-6 record and a 2026 NCAA Tournament berth in her second season.

    Iowa men’s basketball coach Fran McCaffery was ejected from the Big Ten Tournament game against Illinois on March 13, 2025, after receiving two technical fouls for arguing with officials. The incident occurred with 13:33 remaining in the second half, following a foul call and a significant free-throw disparity. 
    This video shows the moment of the ejection during the Iowa vs. Illinois game:
    45s
    Starr Cards
    YouTube• Mar 14, 2025
    • First Technical: McCaffery was assessed a technical foul after leaving the coach's box to argue a foul call on Iowa's Even Brauns.
    • Second Technical & Ejection:
      He continued to argue with officials regarding the call and the 5-to-1 free-throw disparity at the time, resulting in a second technical foul and an automatic ejection.
    • Context: The game was a second-round matchup in the 2025 Big Ten Tournament, which Illinois ultimately won 106-94.
    • Aftermath: Following the loss, which concluded Iowa's season, reports indicated the school was set to part ways with the longtime coach.
